items.raw_excerpt: This vibrant Karoo farming community has history, outdoor adventures for everyone, and a bunch of farm stalls to delight.

The community features historical sites including an ominous tunnel and an old train, along with outdoor adventures and charming farm stalls. Visitors can discover the Poor School and various local padstals that showcase the area's rich heritage.

items.raw_excerpt: For 250 years, the space was dedicated solely to navigation, but it can now be visited.
items.summary_en: A historic Portuguese lighthouse that was closed to visitors for 250 years has finally reopened. The lighthouse at Cabo da Roca, the westernmost point of mainland Europe, was previously used only for maritime navigation. Visitors can now explore the iconic landmark and enjoy stunning views of the Atlantic Ocean.

items.summary_en: Police and park rangers are conducting joint patrols in Poland's Tatra National Park after a series of tourist rule-breaking incidents, including a Ukrainian influencer who drove a sports car to a famous lake. items.raw_excerpt: 彰化縣台鐵社頭站開站以來，首度有普悠瑪號停靠！一列從花蓮站出發的「旅遊專列」，260名乘客在旅行社安排下，以火車作為環島的工具，配合遊覽車接駁，今天來到「襪子的故鄉—社頭」。這趟「普悠瑪環島之旅」共3天2夜，23日從花蓮站出發，夜宿台中市，24早上乘接駁遊覽車到社頭，參觀「樂活襪之鄉博物館」、「手套博物館」，中午到社頭站吃「福井食堂」的鐵路便當，之後乘坐普悠瑪號一路到高雄，25日返回花蓮。

items.raw_excerpt: Today's word refers to something you can only find in Sweden.
items.summary_en: The Swedish word 'fjäll' means a high mountain or open fell with no direct English equivalent. It describes the bare, treeless landscapes found in northern Scandinavia. This word shows how the Swedish language captures unique features of its natural environment.

items.title_en: Swedish word of the day: fjäll

items.raw_excerpt: Falling ill during a holiday does not always mean losing your annual leave. But employees in Germany must follow strict reporting rules from day one to get those days back.
items.summary_en: Workers in Germany who fall ill during their vacation can reclaim those days as annual leave. They must follow strict reporting rules from the first day of illness to qualify. This allows employees to save their vacation time for when they are healthy.
